object_meta.meta_value: Need to rent a TV studio, podcast studio, or editing machines?  All are available to everyone, whether you're a member of our space or not!

We are so excited to have you! Please log in if you have an account with us. If you are new, please register for a free Public Access Membership to get started! From there, you will be able to create your profile, book studios, register for events, and more! Once registered, you may upgrade your membership level at any time.
We are excited to welcome you! By choosing a membership, you can connect with the community and begin using the media makerspace. Choose the membership that is right for you!
